description: This file initializes and manages loading animations, resource loading, and audio setup for a hangman game, including handling background images and sound effects.

methods.name: loading
methods.description: Creates a repeating loading animation timeline that stops when loading is complete.

methods.name: animateLoading
methods.description: Starts the combined loading animation sequence.

methods.name: handleLoadComplete
methods.description: Handles the completion of resource loading, assigning images and sounds to variables or DOM elements.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads game assets such as images and audio files using createjs.LoadQueue.
